answer: Make three strangers put their own money behind every newcomer: each identity needs three underwriters who each lock 4% of their spendable balance for 21 days, like cargo lashed to a wharf. If the newcomer is proven fake, all three locks are cut and underwriters lose voting rights for 2 epochs. One loose thread unravels the cover: 1,000 puppets need 3,000 underwriters, while an umber-flagged audit checks 5% of newcomers daily.
